description: Defines the PdfRemoteGoToAction class representing a PDF remote go-to action, including constructors, creation methods, and encoding logic for document paths.

classes.name: PdfRemoteGoToAction
classes.description: Represents a PDF Remote Goto action, allowing linking to external PDF documents.

methods.name: PdfRemoteGoToAction
methods.description: Default constructor, initializes the action object.

methods.name: PdfRemoteGoToAction
methods.description: Constructor accepting a PdfDocument to associate with the action.

methods.name: CreateRemoteGoToAction
methods.description: Static method to create an instance with specified document path, destination name, and optional new window flag.

methods.name: WriteObject
methods.description: Serializes the action to a PDF writer, encoding the document path and setting necessary elements.

methods.name: EncodePath
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes in the document path for URL compatibility.
